name: The Claxton Hotel
accommodation: 36 en-suite rooms: single, double, twin, family and adjoining rooms, 11 on the ground floor
parking: Small first-come car park at the back; passes for parking outside; one EV charger
beachAccess: Directly overlooks the beach and seafront
boardStorage: Secure overnight storage for bikes and golf equipment with notice
confirmedFeatures: Residents' lounge with sea view, bar meals, room service, breakfast included, free Wi-Fi, meeting room
overview: A seafront hotel on Redcar's High Street looking straight over the beach. It has 36 en-suite rooms, including several on the ground floor, a sea-view residents' lounge and bar meals, with breakfast included. Dogs are welcome, and secure storage is available for bikes and golf kit.
surfTripFit: Right on the seafront with secure kit storage on request, it is a practical base for surfing Redcar's reefs and beach.
